bandit_rationale.B301: Joblib/pickle loading is limited to model artifacts selected by the operator; untrusted uploads are out of scope.
bandit_rationale.B403: Pickle is retained only for the established model artifact format and is covered by artifact compatibility tests.
bandit_rationale.B404: Git metadata probes use fixed argument vectors without a shell and never execute configuration-provided commands.
bandit_rationale.B603: Subprocess calls use fixed executables and argument arrays with shell execution disabled.
bandit_rationale.B607: Git is intentionally resolved from the Agent or developer PATH for portable source revision discovery.
